cover.sub: 5 niche ways to stay fast for users
cover.title: from lisbon to helsinki

inner.title: split it by country
inner.body: chrome's ux report publishes speed data per country every month. your global average can look fine while lisbon waits.
inner.label: averages lie

inner.title: the slowest quarter
inner.body: google calls a page good when 75% of loads hit lcp under 2.5 seconds. your slowest quarter of visitors decides the score.
inner.label: p75 rules

inner.title: host your fonts
inner.body: in 2022 a munich court awarded €100 in gdpr damages because google fonts sent a visitor's ip to google. self-hosting is faster and skips the transfer.
inner.label: €100 lesson

inner.title: fibre stops at town
inner.body: eu fibre reached 69% of homes in mid-2024, but only 59% in rural areas. 4 in 10 rural homes open your site without it.
inner.label: no fibre

inner.title: edge beats region
inner.body: pings from greece fell from 37ms to 6ms when served from cloud edge instead of a cloud region. countries without a local region gain the most.
inner.label: 83% less wait
